notes: The supplied *unto* of *lend unto many nations* is placed on the verb under rule 44, because the Hebrew object carries neither a marker nor a preposition.
The note on that unit names נָתַן where the verb is עָבַט; the placement of *unto* under rule 44 is unaffected by the slip.
Where an explicit אַתָּה stands (s017), the verb keeps only its auxiliary and lexical verb, the subject pronoun going to the written pronoun.
